content:
We are happy to announce the second Mathlib Reviewer Bootcamp: it will take place from January 18 to January 22, 2027, near Bonn, Germany, featuring lectures and mentorship from @Yaël Dillies, @Arend Mellendijk, @Christian Merten, @Monica Omar and @Michael Rothgang. Like the first bootcamp, our goal is to help train new Mathlib reviewers through guidence from experienced mentors, allowing Mathlib to keep growing long-term. The webpage has further details.

Applications are now open, until October 31: please fill in this form. Feel free to contact either of us through Zulip if you need to apply immediately for e.g. visa or travel funding applications, and we will do our best to support your case (including with a quick decision on your case).

Yael Dillies, Arend Mellendijk and Michael Rothgang
